plan.title: Create Single-Stage RFQ from Asset PR

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation as required by the case.

args.need: choose Single Stage, select RFQ as the event type, and stop on the RFQ create screen

steps.note: The catalog has no PR-flow step for choosing Single Stage or configuring its RFQ event type.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Assert that an RFQ template is applied before configuring the sheet.
Verify that the create screen exposes the PR-derived item, quantity, variant, and delivery-location columns.
Assert that core PR-derived item fields are read-only on the pricing sheet.
Add the two vendors named in the case to the event.
Publish the completed PR-derived RFQ; this step handles the publish confirmation.
Assert that publishing reached a real event project page.
Open the published event's Settings menu to inspect PR-specific actions.
Verify that Recreate Order is greyed out for an event created from a PR.
